title.en: An Act Amending and Repealing Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred and Twenty, Regarding Public Works Projects for the Province of Cebu

text.en:
Item 17 (f), for the Province of Cebu, paragraph (a), Title E, section one of Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred twenty, is amended to read as follows:
"(f) Carmen Waterworks-Construction ₱65,000.00"

The following new items are inserted after item 17 (h), for the Province of Cebu, paragraph (a), Title E, section one of Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred twenty:
"(h-1) Barrio San Juan Waterworks, Municipality of Pilar-Construction ₱2,000.00 "(h-2) Barrio Villa Hermosa Waterworks, Municipality of Pilar-Construction 2,000.00" "(h-3) Barrio Kawit Waterworks, Municipality of Pilar-Construction 6,000.00"
Item 17 (c), paragraph (a), Title C, and item 3 (x), paragraph (a), Title H, of section one of said Republic Act, are repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 11, 1955.
